projects.name: StayEase Pro
details: StayEase Pro
Developed a comprehensive hotel reservation system using Java 8 and Spring Boot, integrating MySQL for robust data
management. Implemented microservices architecture with Eureka Server for service registry and discovery and Angular for
the FrontEnd part. Utilized Spring Security with JWT for secure user authentication.  Created RESTful APIs for efficient
booking and management functionalities. Employed JUnit and Mockito for rigorous unit and integration testing. Automated
deployments using Jenkins and Docker, ensuring continuous delivery and operational efficiency.

projects.name: Roles and Responsibility
details: Roles and Responsibility
– Designed and developed RESTful APIs using Spring Boot (Microservices architecture) for scalable hotel
management services
– Built responsive frontend modules using Angular (components, services, routing) to provide an intuitive booking
and account management experience.
– Implemented JWT-based authentication and Spring Security to secure APIs and enable role-based access control.
– Built an admin dashboard for user and role management, ensuring controlled access to system resources.
– Integrated Hibernate (ORM) with MySQL for effecient database operations, entity mapping, and caching.

entry.text: Roles and Responsibility
– Designed and developed RESTful APIs using Spring Boot (Microservices architecture) for scalable hotel
management services
– Built responsive frontend modules using Angular (components, services, routing) to provide an intuitive booking
and account management experience.
– Implemented JWT-based authentication and Spring Security to secure APIs and enable role-based access control.
– Built an admin dashboard for user and role management, ensuring controlled access to system resources.
– Integrated Hibernate (ORM) with MySQL for effecient database operations, entity mapping, and caching.
– Deployed the application on AWS Cloud, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance optimization.
– Implemented third-party integrations (Email, SMS, Whatsapp) to improve customer communication and
booking/payment notifications.
– Developed audit logging and error handling routines to maintain traceability and transaction reliability.
– Conducted unit testing (JUnit) and integration testing (Postman) to ensure system stability and API performance.
– Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features aligned with business needs.
